# nuyina.underway

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of nuyina.underway is to get the Nuyina underway data. 



This layer `underway:nuyina_underway` is published at this address, but we regularly cache this in convenient tabular form and only request from the service what data is new. 

'https://data.aad.gov.au/geoserver/ows?service=WFS&acceptversions=2.0.0&request=GetCapabilities'. 

The cache lives here, and can be read at any time with Parquet readers (Arrow, GDAL, etc): 

'https://github.com/mdsumner/nuyina-underway/releases/download/v0.0.1/nuyina_underway.parquet'

## Installation

You can install the development version of nuyina.underway like so:

``` r
remotes::install_github("mdsumner/nuyina.underway")
```

## Example

This is a basic example. 

```{r example}
library(nuyina.underway)
d <- nuyina_underway() ; print(length(names(d)))
d |> dplyr::select(datetime, longitude, latitude, platform_pitch_fore_up,sea_water_temperature) |> tail()
```

## Where things live

The landing page for everything Nuyina underway is
<https://mdsumner.github.io/nuyina-underway/>.

- [mdsumner/nuyina-underway](https://github.com/mdsumner/nuyina-underway): the
  aggregator. GitHub Actions pull the AAD GeoServer WFS into a Parquet file on
  its v0.0.1 release, and its `docs/` holds the landing page and the Proximal
  tracker app.
- [mdsumner/nuyina.underway](https://github.com/mdsumner/nuyina.underway): R
  package to read the data up to minutes-recent (Parquet cache plus live WFS).
  Its `envdata/` holds the satellite environmental-data extraction, folded in
  from nuyina.envdata.
- [mdsumner/seaice.map](https://github.com/mdsumner/seaice.map): targets
  pipeline rendering the sea ice and vessel map to Pawsey object storage
  (bucket nuyina.map).

Archived and folded: nuyina-proximal (now `docs/proximal/` in
nuyina-underway), nuyina.envdata (now `envdata/` in nuyina.underway).
